jobs.title: SLASH · The green coat
jobs.prompt: a single full-page comic drawing (1 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Title of the strip: BACKUP. The strip: Page one of the phantom novel: a woman in a green coat at the frame shop's counter at closing with a photograph she wants matted and won't let the framer see. Rain in the alley in vertical hatching. The framer isn't Wood; he has Wood's hands. Panel 1: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, a frame shop at closing with rain hatched in the window, a woman in a dark coat sliding a photograph face-down across a counter to a man whose ink-stained hands rest on it. Green Coat says "Mat it. Don't look at it.". Framer says "I have to measure it.". Green Coat says "Measure the back.". Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized gull, two strokes. Reference @loc_frame_shop shows the setting; keep its architecture and props. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @loc_frame_shop for the setting; @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17.
